name: Easil
description_en:
Easil is a browser design service for branded graphics and short videos, with templates, layers, resizing and shared brand assets. Its distinctive team workflow combines Designer-controlled editing restrictions with Brand Manager approval before a member can download or order a protected design.

It fits teams that adapt approved campaign templates into local variations. The Basic plan is free and starts with a 30-day Plus trial; brand workflows, richer exports and other tools require paid plans. Template access, paid editing capability and rights to reuse stock-containing output are separate conditions: the terms impose active-subscription and permitted-use restrictions that matter for client handoff and cancellation.
description_zh:
Easil 是面向品牌图形和短视频的浏览器设计服务，提供模板、图层、调整尺寸及共享品牌资产。其团队流程把 Designer 控制的编辑限制与 Brand Manager 审批结合，成员使用受保护设计时需获批才能下载或订印。

它适合把获批活动模板改成本地版本的团队。Basic 免费，并附起始 30 天 Plus 试用；品牌工作流、更丰富导出等工具需要付费。模板访问、付费编辑功能与含图库素材输出的复用权是独立条件；条款中的有效订阅及许可用途限制会影响客户交接与取消后的使用。

core_features.explanation_en: Collections link campaign sizes; contextual ActionBar controls and layers edit text, images and graphics.
core_features.explanation_zh: Collection 关联活动尺寸，情境 ActionBar 与图层编辑文字、图像和图形。

core_features.explanation_en: A Designer can restrict a whole document or selected element while leaving chosen content editable.
core_features.explanation_zh: Designer 可限制整个文档或指定元素，并保留选定内容可编辑。

core_features.explanation_en: Protected team templates require Brand Manager approval for ordinary members; edits require a new approved copy.
core_features.explanation_zh: 普通成员使用受保护团队模板须经 Brand Manager 批准；修改后副本需重新审批。

pricing.source_snapshot_en: Basic free with initial 30-day Plus trial. Plus USD7.50/user/month or USD75/year; Edge USD59/user/month or USD588/year. Enterprise quote.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: Basic 免费并附初始 30 天 Plus 试用。Plus 每人每月 7.50 美元或每年 75 美元；Edge 每人每月 59 美元或每年 588 美元；Enterprise 询价。

sections.title_en: Make reusable local variations of a brand design
sections.title_zh: 制作可复用的品牌本地版本
sections.en:
Easil offers templates for social posts, menus, posters, business cards and other digital/print assets. Users upload their own images/video, arrange layers, apply text masks/effects and resize designs; the Collection feature links campaign sizes for updating text, images and video across them. Brand kits keep colors, fonts, logos and images together. These are design-management capabilities, not evidence of automatic publishing to every social network.

Editorial example: a head office prepares a promotion and lets local staff change a date and approved product photo while protecting the logo and legal text. This is a stronger fit than treating every staff member as an unrestricted designer. It is less appropriate where the output must be a fully portable source project, unrestricted stock resale or a guaranteed professional print result without proofing.
sections.zh:
Easil 提供社交帖子、菜单、海报、名片等数字/印刷素材模板。用户可上传图像/视频、排列图层、使用文字蒙版和效果、调整尺寸；Collection 可关联活动的多种尺寸并更新其文字、图像和视频。品牌工具包集中颜色、字体、标志和图像。这些属于设计管理能力，不证明可自动发布到每个社交平台。

编辑示例：总部建立促销设计，让本地人员修改日期及获准产品图，同时保护标志和法律文字。这适合受控模板协作。如果要求完全可移植的源项目、无限制图库再售，或无需校样即保证专业印刷效果，则应另行核对。

sections.title_en: Build and inspect the campaign before requesting approval
sections.title_zh: 审批前完成并检查活动设计
sections.en:
The [editing guide](https://support.easil.com/editing-basics-in-easil/) starts from a loaded design: select an element to expose contextual ActionBar controls for opacity, angle, position, scale, duplication and deletion. Use the sidebar for pages, layouts, text, images, graphics, assets and layers. The Page tab navigates campaign sizes; Layers changes stacking, groups objects, hides optional elements and rearranges pages. The Layouts tool for adding/replacing pages is documented for Plus and Edge.

For the promotion example, upload a licensed photo, edit the text, group related objects, check each campaign size and inspect image crop and text overflow. Some decorative text graphics are explicitly non-editable; a locked or ornamental item is not necessarily an editor failure. Before exporting PNG, print PDF or MP4 under an eligible plan, check the actual output rather than assuming a template or automatic resize has preserved every visual detail.
sections.zh:
[编辑指南](https://support.easil.com/editing-basics-in-easil/)从载入设计开始：选择元素，ActionBar 会显示透明度、角度、位置、缩放、复制和删除等情境控件。侧栏用于页面、布局、文字、图片、图形、资产及图层。Page 导航活动尺寸，Layers 调整堆叠、分组、隐藏可选元素及重排页面；添加/替换页面的 Layouts 工具文档注明用于 Plus 和 Edge。

促销示例可先上传有权使用的照片、修改文字、分组相关对象，再逐个尺寸检查裁切及文字溢出。部分装饰文字图形明确不可编辑；锁定或装饰项无法修改不一定是编辑器故障。使用相应套餐导出 PNG、印刷 PDF 或 MP4 前，应检查实际输出，不能假定模板或自动缩放已保留全部细节。

sections.title_en: Document restrictions and element locks have different scope
sections.title_zh: 文档限制与元素锁定范围不同
sections.en:
The [restriction guide](https://support.easil.com/locking-restrictions/) requires the Designer permission to configure locks. Restrictions affect team members without that role. Whole-document controls can stop adding non-brand colors/fonts/images, text, pages or links, changing the background, rearranging layers, and resizing/copying a design. Element controls separately govern deletion, placement, text editing, image replacement, cropping, styling and more. A partial lock intentionally allows only selected changes.

For a local template, leave offer text and the image replacement action available while locking placement, font and logo. Text Boundary constrains text to the designer’s box and defaults to locking several related typography/position options. If a colleague cannot change something, inspect their role and the relevant document/element restriction before rebuilding the design. These controls protect the template workflow; they do not establish a universal security boundary for downloaded files.
sections.zh:
[限制指南](https://support.easil.com/locking-restrictions/)要求具备 Designer 权限才能设锁，限制针对没有该角色的团队成员。文档级控件可禁止添加非品牌颜色/字体/图像、文字、页面或链接，禁止改背景、重排图层及缩放/复制设计。元素级控件则分别管理删除、位置、文字编辑、替换图片、裁切及样式等；部分锁定意味着有意只开放某些修改。

本地模板可开放优惠文字和替换图片，同时锁住位置、字体及标志。Text Boundary 把文字限制在设计者的框内，并默认锁定相关排版/位置选项。同事无法修改时，应先检查角色和对应文档/元素限制，再考虑重做设计。这些控件保护模板流程，不证明下载文件具备通用安全边界。

sections.en:
A Brand Manager enables approval on a Team Template using its card menu. A member without Brand Manager permissions can request approval from the editor or Workspace and add a comment. While pending, the design becomes uneditable unless the request is canceled. A Brand Manager reviews and approves or declines it. The protected member cannot download or order it beforehand.

Approved designs remain locked. To change one, the member creates an unlocked copy which must be approved again before download. A declined request can be resubmitted or reverted to draft for editing; Brand Managers can also unapprove an approved design. This is a documented approval workflow, not a claim that someone independently checked brand accuracy, asset rights or the final printed product.
sections.zh:
Brand Manager 在 Team Template 卡片菜单启用审批。没有 Brand Manager 权限的成员可从编辑器或 Workspace 申请并添加评论。等待期间设计不可编辑，除非取消申请；Brand Manager 审阅后批准或拒绝。在获批前，该成员不能下载或订印受保护设计。

获批设计仍锁定。要修改，成员需创建可编辑副本，并在下载前重新获批。被拒申请可直接重提，也可退回草稿修改后再提；Brand Manager 还可撤销批准。这是文档中的审批流程，不代表品牌准确性、素材权利或最终印品已经独立核查。

sections.title_en: Per-user plans and ambiguous credit periods
sections.title_zh: 按人方案及未明确的点数周期
sections.en:
The USD cards show Plus at $7.50/user/month or $75 billed yearly (equivalent to $6.25/month), and Edge at $59/user/month or $588 yearly ($49/month equivalent). The page labels the equivalents as “per user / year” beside the explicit annual totals; this draft uses the billed totals rather than interpreting $6.25 or $49 as the entire annual fee. AUD pricing is separate. Enterprise is quoted.

Basic lists 2,500+ templates, image uploads, layers/groups and photo folders. Plus lists 10,000+ templates, video, PNG/print PDF/MP4 downloads, custom fonts, resizing, brand kits, locks and approvals. Edge lists 30,000+ templates, animation and its design guarantee. Background removal shows 10 credits for Plus and 50 for Edge, without a confirmed reset period. Do not assume monthly replenishment. The 30-day Plus trial converts to Basic unless converted to paid under the terms. Taxes, checkout and guarantee scope were not tested.
sections.zh:
美元卡片显示 Plus 每人每月 $7.50，或年付 $75（折合每月 $6.25）；Edge 每人每月 $59，或年付 $588（折合每月 $49）。页面把折合数额标成“per user / year”，但同时明确年度账单总额；本文采用总额，不把 $6.25 或 $49 解读为全年费用。澳元报价独立，Enterprise 询价。

Basic 列出 2,500+ 模板、上传图片、图层/分组及照片文件夹；Plus 列出 10,000+ 模板、视频、PNG/印刷 PDF/MP4 下载、自定义字体、改尺寸、品牌工具包、锁定及审批；Edge 列出 30,000+ 模板、动画及设计保证。背景移除为 Plus 10 点、Edge 50 点，未确认重置周期，不能假定每月补充。条款表示 30 天 Plus 试用未转付费则转 Basic。税费、结账及保证具体范围未实测。

sections.title_en: A stock-containing design has continuing license conditions
sections.title_zh: 含图库元素的设计有持续许可条件
sections.en:
The [terms](https://about.easil.com/terms-of-use/) call Easil proprietary SaaS. Clauses 3, 8 and 11 require an active appropriate subscription for use/reuse of Easil Designs, including previously downloaded work; they prohibit stockpiling downloads for after expiry or downgrading to retain higher-plan uses. “Easil Design” broadly includes a work containing its stock, fonts, graphics or templates. A free Basic license is still a subscription under these terms, not perpetual unrestricted asset ownership.

Permitted-use examples include promotional print uses up to 2,000 prints and electronic publications limited to 480,000 total pixels per stock-media file. Reselling/extracting individual stock elements is prohibited. Extra commercial/resale rights for Plus/Edge concern independently created work without any Easil Design elements, with active-subscription conditions. Client transfer must be of the whole end product, during an active subscription, with the client informed of corresponding IP obligations. These are vendor contract provisions, not legal clearance for a particular project; obtain clarification for long-lived campaigns, larger print runs or post-cancellation use.
sections.zh:
[条款](https://about.easil.com/terms-of-use/)把 Easil 定义为专有 SaaS。第 3、8、11 条要求以有效且合适的订阅使用/复用 Easil Design，包括此前下载的作品，禁止囤积下载供到期后使用或降级后继续高阶用途。“Easil Design”广泛涵盖含其图库、字体、图形或模板的作品。免费 Basic 许可按这些条款仍属于订阅，不是永久无限制拥有素材。

许可用途示例包括最多 2,000 份的促销印刷，以及每个图库媒体文件总计不超过 480,000 像素的电子出版。禁止拆出或再售单独图库元素。Plus/Edge 的额外商业/再售权针对完全独立创作且不含任何 Easil Design 元素的作品，也有有效订阅条件。客户交接须在有效订阅期转移整个成品，并告知客户相应知识产权义务。这些是厂商合同条文，不是对具体项目的法律清权；长期活动、大印量或取消后使用应取得明确解释。
